08 · How It Works

From metering to mist.

The complete fluid and air path shows how two independently metered streams become one controlled spray.

09 · Intelligent Control

One controller. Three actuators. Continuous feedback.

The controller coordinates metering and atomization while receiving pressure feedback from the liquid line.

MeterPumps
MonitorPressure
AtomizeCompressor
AdaptController
10 · Power Architecture

Two voltage rails. One compact electrical system.

12 V powers the actuators. A regulated 5 V rail supplies control and sensing.

12 · Engineering Challenge

Why the system had to be different.

The design choices above respond directly to the limitations of conventional biological and drone spraying systems.

01

Biosynthetic solutions are difficult to spray

Viscous · Non-Newtonian · Biologically Sensitive

02

Existing high-viscosity systems are too large

Heavy · High-Pressure · Stationary

03

Current drone sprayers use fixed formulations

Fixed Formulation → Adaptive Formulation

The platform is designed to keep evolving.

Future work moves the prototype from controlled delivery toward a fully adaptive field system.
